description: Unauthorized Access to Admin Interface Without proper role-based access control (RBAC) and IAM policies, administrative interfaces could be accessed by regular users or attackers who obtain valid credentials. An attacker with valid user credentials attempts to access admin endpoints by manipulating API requests, potentially gaining elevated privileges.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1550 - Use Alternate Authentication Material
recommendation: Implement strict RBAC using Cognito Groups and IAM roles
recommendation: Implement administrative API endpoint protection

description: API Rate Limiting Bypass Without rate limiting, attackers can flood the API with requests, potentially exhausting resources or causing service degradation. An attacker scripts multiple concurrent requests to API endpoints, causing increased latency or failures for legitimate users.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1499 - Endpoint Denial of Service
recommendation: Implement API Gateway usage plans and throttling

description: Container Scaling Security Issues Improper scaling configurations can lead to container termination without proper connection draining, causing service disruptions. During high load, rapid scaling events could cause connection drops or expose container metadata to attackers.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1499.004 - Application or System Exploitation
recommendation: Implement proper container scaling configuration
recommendation: Consider migration to EKS or AWS App Runner

description: Analytics Pipeline Data Access Control Issues Lack of fine-grained access controls and data filtering in the analytics pipeline could expose sensitive data to unauthorized users. references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Implement data access controls throughout analytics pipeline
recommendation: Implement data transformation and filtering
